name: United Arab Emirates
tagline: Western degrees in the Gulf — and one of the world's most generous aid policies
summary: The UAE is a shopping centre of imported universities. Dubai's academic free zones host British, Australian, Indian and American campuses awarding their home degrees; Abu Dhabi hosts NYU and the Sorbonne. Teaching is in English almost everywhere, the IB is read as a matter of routine, and the academic calendar is American — apply in the autumn, start in August or September. One institution stands out and deserves separate consideration: NYU Abu Dhabi, which meets full demonstrated financial need for admitted students regardless of nationality, with all aid for non-Emiratis awarded on need rather than merit. Against a 2026-27 cost of attendance of USD 90,434, that policy is the difference between an impossible option and a free one.
whyConsider: NYU Abu Dhabi awards need-based financial aid to non-Emirati students and is one of the very few universities outside the United States that does so at this scale — its 2026-27 cost of attendance is USD 90,434, and a Danish family on an ordinary income would typically pay a fraction of it.
Dubai's branch campuses award the home institution's degree — a Heriot-Watt, Birmingham, Wollongong or Middlesex degree, recognised in Europe, obtained in the Gulf.
Everything is taught in English and the IB is a standard entry qualification throughout.
The American calendar suits IB students: applications in the autumn and early winter, decisions in the spring, start in August.
No income tax, a large and young international population, and flight connections to everywhere — Copenhagen is around seven hours.
watchOuts: The UAE is four admissions environments wearing one flag, and the difference between them is months. NYU Abu Dhabi closes on 1 November 2026 for a 2027 start. RIT Dubai will still take an application on 22 August 2027. Heriot-Watt Dubai will take one three weeks before term. Get this wrong in either direction and you either miss the option or spend a year assuming you have more time than you do.

A branch campus is not the parent university with better weather. It is licensed separately by MoHESR through the Commission for Academic Accreditation and, in Dubai, permitted by KHDA, and it teaches a subset of the parent’s programmes with its own staff. What it does share is the degree and, at Birmingham Dubai explicitly, the entry requirements. Check both before assuming either.

A Dubai campus application does not go through UCAS and does not use one of your five UCAS choices. Birmingham Dubai says so in terms. That is an advantage worth knowing about, and it is also why a UK branch campus will not appear anywhere in your UCAS planning.

Nine of the fourteen institutions here have not published a 2027 date at all. Four say so explicitly and five simply do not publish one — the distinction is recorded deadline by deadline. Either way, autumn 2026 is when you re-check, and this record tells you which page to re-check.

Every foreign school certificate needs attestation by the local education authority and an equivalency certificate from the UAE Ministry of Education. Khalifa University states that applications with missing documents will not be accepted. This is slow and it is not optional.
We could not verify a UAE tuition figure other than NYU Abu Dhabi’s and Khalifa’s during this research. Those figures are left blank on purpose and have to be checked on the university’s own page.

Whether NYU Abu Dhabi is formally need-blind for international applicants could not be confirmed from its own pages. What is confirmed is that all financial aid grants for non-Emirati citizens are need-based; the only named merit scholarship is reserved for Emirati nationals. Ask admissions directly whether your financial need affects the admission decision.

NYU Abu Dhabi is extraordinarily selective — admission rates are in the low single digits, comparable to the most selective American universities — and its Early Decision rounds are binding. You are released from that agreement only if the aid package will not let you attend.

The federal universities are not really open to you. UAEU and Zayed direct places and subsidies at UAE nationals and children of Emirati mothers, who apply through a national placement route, and run international admission as a separate and much smaller stream. Establish eligibility before investing effort.

The UAE is socially conservative by Danish standards. Laws on alcohol, relationships outside marriage and public behaviour differ from what you are used to, and enforcement varies by emirate. Read the Danish foreign ministry’s travel advice properly, not the marketing brochures.
Summer heat in Dubai and Abu Dhabi is extreme — 45°C is routine in July and August — and outdoor life effectively stops for three months.
Denmark’s SU works differently for a full degree outside the EU/EEA. Check su.dk before budgeting.

ibRecognition.minimumPoints: There is no national minimum. Two institutions publish one: Khalifa University requires the full Diploma with a minimum of 4 in each of six HL/SL subjects and a total of 24 points, and RIT Dubai requires 28 points for engineering and 24 for computing, business, psychology and new media design. Every other UAE minimum in this record is unestablished, and none of these two figures may be read across to any other institution.
ibRecognition.subjectLevelRule: Set by each institution, not nationally. Khalifa University requires Mathematics as a mandatory subject plus one science (Physics, Biology or Chemistry) depending on the programme, and excludes Islamic Education from the six subjects it counts. RIT Dubai requires Mathematics, Physics and one of Chemistry or Biology at grade 4 or above for engineering. Branch campuses apply the parent university’s subject rules — Birmingham Dubai states that it upholds the same entry requirements as its UK campus.
ibRecognition.gradeConversion: No national conversion table. UAE institutions read IB points directly. What they do require, and what no European system asks for, is an equivalency certificate for the Diploma issued by the UAE Ministry of Education, on top of attestation of the transcript by the local education authority — KHDA in Dubai, ADEK in Abu Dhabi, SPEA in Sharjah.
notes: The IB is standard currency here — the UAE has one of the largest concentrations of IB World Schools in the region, so admissions offices read the transcript fluently.

Khalifa University also grants advanced standing credit for a score of 6 or higher on certain HL subjects, which can shorten the degree. It does not grant credit for lower scores, and if an exam is taken twice the higher score counts.

RIT Dubai places students into English courses by IB English grade rather than by test: 7 and 4–6 both reach its highest writing course, 3 reaches the one below. That is a rare case of an institution publishing how it actually reads an IB subject grade.

Branch campuses generally apply the same IB requirements as the home institution, which makes their entry standards easy to look up on the parent university’s site — and means the parent’s site, not the Dubai one, is the page to trust.

The Commission for Academic Accreditation licenses institutions and accredits programmes nationally; KHDA licenses and certifies degrees in Dubai and ADEK in Abu Dhabi. Check that your programme appears on the accredited list if you intend to use the degree in the Gulf.
Minimum IB scores are not established for the other twelve institutions in this record. That is a gap in our research, not evidence that they have none.

portal.name: No central portal. The UAE has three admissions environments and which one you are in decides everything about how and when you apply: federal institutions, UAE private universities, and branch campuses of foreign universities — and, on its own, NYU Abu Dhabi, which admits through NYU in New York on the American calendar.

deadlines.label: NYU Abu Dhabi — Early Decision I closes
deadlines.notes: NYUAD publishes 1 November as a bare recurring date with no year, so the 2027-entry year is inferred and the date is marked provisional. Early Decision is binding: if you are admitted with a financial aid package you can afford, you must withdraw your other applications and accept within two to three weeks. You are released from the agreement only if the aid package does not enable you to attend. Decisions are released 15 December.

deadlines.label: NYU Abu Dhabi — Early Decision II closes
deadlines.notes: Also binding. The year is inferred from a bare recurring date, so the date is provisional. Decisions are released 15 February.

deadlines.label: NYU Abu Dhabi — Regular Decision closes
deadlines.notes: The non-binding round, and the one to use unless you are certain. The year is inferred from a bare recurring date, so the date is provisional. Decisions are released 1 April. The CSS Profile for financial aid is due 1 February — a separate date, and missing that one costs the money rather than the place.

deadlines.label: Khalifa University — Fall 2027 application timeline
deadlines.notes: Khalifa's undergraduate admissions page says Fall 2026 admissions are closed and, under the heading "Know the application timeline and deadlines", carries the single line "Stay tuned for the Fall 2027 application timeline". There is no date to record because the university has not set one. Check the page from autumn 2026. Admission is competitive and seat-limited, shortlisted applicants sit the Khalifa University Admission Test in person, and every applicant submits a video recording in place of an interview — so the working deadline is well before the stated one.

deadlines.label: American University of Sharjah — Fall 2027 applications open
deadlines.notes: AUS opens Fall 2027 and Spring 2027 applications on the same day. The page states that dates are tentative and subject to change.

deadlines.label: American University of Sharjah — Early File Completion for Fall 2027
deadlines.notes: The only Fall 2027 date AUS publishes between opening and the first day of classes. Note what it collides with: IB results are released on 6 July 2027, the day after. A file expected to be complete by 5 July cannot contain your final diploma, so ask AUS in writing what it will accept instead and when it wants the final transcript.

deadlines.label: American University of Sharjah — Fall 2027 application closing date
deadlines.notes: AUS publishes a row reading "Deadline for Spring 2027 applications" (24 December 2026) and one reading "Deadline for Summer 2027 applications" (13 May 2027). The Fall 2027 block has no equivalent row. We opened the page and the date was not on it — that is a gap in what AUS publishes, not a finding that Fall applications never close.

deadlines.label: Heriot-Watt University Dubai — September 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: There is no deadline because there is no round. The Dubai campus states that it runs a rolling year-round admissions process and starts accepting applications for the next intake as soon as one closes, that most students apply six to ten months ahead, and that it can accept applications up until three weeks before the start of each intake — with the warning that a late application will delay the student visa and matriculation card. Three weeks before a September start is late August 2027.

deadlines.label: University of Birmingham Dubai — September 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: No application deadline appears on the Dubai campus's how-to-apply page or its application FAQs. What is published instead: you apply directly through the University's own admissions portal rather than UCAS, there is no application fee, and a decision follows within ten working days of a complete application. You may apply on predicted grades or first-term Year 13 results. The date that actually binds is the visa sponsorship deadline, recorded separately below.

deadlines.label: University of Birmingham Dubai — visa sponsorship deadline, September 2027 intake
deadlines.notes: This, not the application, is the hard date for anyone applying from outside the UAE. Birmingham Dubai publishes a deadline for new international students to apply for a University-sponsored visa from outside the UAE: Monday 24 August 2026 for the September 2026 intake (express, Monday 31 August 2026), and Monday 14 December 2026 for the January 2027 intake (express, Monday 21 December 2026). The September 2027 equivalent is not yet published and is not inferred here.

deadlines.label: Middlesex University Dubai — September 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Middlesex Dubai's how-to-apply page lists the stages of an application — offer of admission, student visa, credit transfer, accommodation, scholarship, tuition fees — and no date of any kind. We opened it and there was nothing to record. Ask admissions directly for a closing date before planning around one.

deadlines.label: University of Wollongong in Dubai — Autumn 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: UOWD's academic calendar covers Autumn 2026 only and carries no admission application deadline at all — every date on it is subject enrolment, tuition instalments, examinations or results. No Autumn 2027 calendar is published. UOWD teaches on the Australian trimester pattern and its Autumn 2026 session began on 21 September 2026.

deadlines.label: RIT Dubai — Fall 2027 Early Admission Phase closes
deadlines.notes: RIT Dubai's page says it is already accepting applications for Spring and Fall 2027. The phase dates are published without a year, so 2027 is inferred and the date is provisional. Apply in this phase if you want a scholarship: RIT Dubai says its scholarship seats are limited and urges applicants to apply as soon as they can.

deadlines.label: RIT Dubai — Fall 2027 Regular Admission Phase closes
deadlines.notes: The year is inferred from a bare recurring date, so the date is provisional. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis within the phases.

deadlines.label: RIT Dubai — Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.notes: The consequence is chosen deliberately: RIT Dubai states that an application received after the deadline will be reviewed based on space availability, which is consideration at the university's discretion rather than a closed door. The year is inferred from a bare recurring date, so the date is provisional. It falls after IB results on 6 July 2027, which makes RIT Dubai one of the few UAE options a student can still act on with a finished diploma in hand.

deadlines.label: American University in Dubai — Fall 2027 applications
deadlines.notes: AUD publishes month ranges rather than dates: for the Fall semester, early applications "up until March/April" and late applications "through July/August". No calendar date is given for any year, so there is nothing to put in a date field. Write to admissions for the actual closing date.

deadlines.label: Canadian University Dubai — Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.notes: CUD publishes deadlines one academic year at a time and currently shows 2026-27 only: Fall, 21 August 2026 for international applicants and 27 August 2026 for domestic; Spring, 3 January 2027 and 8 January 2027; Summer, 12 May 2027 and 19 May 2027. CUD sets the international deadline about a week earlier than the domestic one, which is a pattern to check for when the 2027-28 dates appear rather than a figure to carry over.

deadlines.label: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi — September 2027 application deadline
deadlines.notes: Sorbonne Abu Dhabi published 21 August 2026 as the deadline for all undergraduate programmes for the September 2026/2027 intake. The equivalent 2027 date is not yet published and is not inferred here. Two other dates on the same page matter: the AED 200 application fee is non-refundable, and an admission offer must be accepted no later than two weeks before the academic year starts.

deadlines.label: Zayed University — Fall 2027 application dates
deadlines.notes: Zayed University's undergraduate application page carries the line "Application Dates to be confirmed" in place of a deadline. International applicants apply through the university's e-services form rather than the national placement route Emirati school-leavers use, and are told to contact the Abu Dhabi or Dubai undergraduate admissions office directly.

deadlines.label: United Arab Emirates University — Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.notes: UAEU publishes an application portal and the rule that students are admitted competitively within the available capacity of each college, and publishes no undergraduate deadline we could find — graduate deadlines are published, undergraduate ones are not. UAEU also routes international students and children of UAEU staff separately from UAE nationals and children of Emirati mothers, so establish which stream you are in before asking for a date.

deadlines.label: SP Jain School of Global Management, Dubai — 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Not established. SP Jain's undergraduate pages describe the multi-city structure and the Australian degree it leads to, and publish no application deadline for a 2027 intake. The degree is Australian, at AQF Level 7, and CRICOS-registered, so the Australian regulator's rules follow the student across all four campuses.

deadlines.label: IB results released
deadlines.notes: Where each UAE institution sits relative to this date is the most useful single thing on this page. NYU Abu Dhabi closes eight months before it and decides on predicted grades. AUS wants a complete file the day before it. RIT Dubai's deadline falls seven weeks after it. Heriot-Watt Dubai will still take an application three weeks before term starts. The UAE is not one calendar, and treating it as one is how a student loses a year.

steps: Work out which of the four admissions environments your institution is in before anything else. It decides the portal, the calendar, the entry rules and the degree you end up with.

For NYU Abu Dhabi, apply through the Common Application on the American timetable: Early Decision I on 1 November, Early Decision II on 1 January, Regular Decision on 5 January, all at 23:59 EST. Early Decision is binding. File the CSS Profile for financial aid alongside it — 10 November, 10 January or 1 February depending on the round.

For a branch campus, read the parent university’s entry requirements first. Birmingham Dubai states that it upholds the same entry requirements as its UK campus, and Heriot-Watt Dubai awards the same Scottish degree. Then apply through the UAE campus’s own portal, not through UCAS — a Dubai application does not use one of your five UCAS choices.

For a UAE private university — Khalifa, AUS, AUD, CUD — apply direct on its own calendar. These are the institutions whose 2027 dates are least likely to be published yet, so diarise a check for autumn 2026.

For a federal institution — UAEU, Zayed — check first whether the international stream is open to you at all. Places and subsidies are directed at UAE nationals and children of Emirati mothers, who apply through a national placement route you cannot use.

Have every foreign certificate attested and equivalenced by the UAE Ministry of Education. Khalifa and RIT Dubai both make this an explicit condition, and the process is slow. Start it long before you have an offer.
Apply for financial aid at the same time as admission wherever the two are linked, not afterwards.

Once admitted, the university sponsors your student residence visa — you cannot arrange it yourself. Allow for a medical fitness test and an Emirates ID on arrival, and note that some institutions set a visa deadline weeks before term that is harder than the application deadline.
Sort accommodation through the university; most of the Abu Dhabi institutions house undergraduates on campus.
application.selectionNotes: Selection does not mean the same thing in the four environments. NYU Abu Dhabi assesses holistically on the American model with essays, references and a candidate weekend, and admits in the low single digits. Khalifa screens against published minimums, shortlists, then requires its own admission test in person and a video recording in place of an interview. The Dubai branch campuses apply the parent university’s published entry requirements and are generally accessible to a solid IB student. The federal institutions select within each college’s capacity and prioritise Emirati nationals ahead of everyone else.

language.englishTaughtBachelors: Essentially all of them. English is the medium of instruction across the private and branch-campus sector and at NYU Abu Dhabi, Khalifa and the American University of Sharjah. Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi teaches substantially in French.
language.englishProof: IB English is normally accepted. Some institutions require IELTS or TOEFL regardless of the IB — not verified institution by institution.
notes: Arabic is the official language but English is the working language of the country, and in Dubai you can live for years without needing Arabic.
Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi is the exception: it delivers French university programmes and most of its teaching is in French, with a French-language preparatory year available.
Federal institutions such as UAE University and Zayed University teach some programmes in Arabic — check the medium of instruction.

tuitionEuEea.value: The UAE does not differentiate by nationality in the way Europe does. Most private institutions charge the same fee to everyone; federal institutions prioritise or subsidise Emirati nationals. See tuitionNonEu.

tuitionNonEu.value: NYU Abu Dhabi 2026-27: tuition USD 68,574, housing USD 6,000, food USD 5,800, total direct costs USD 84,520 including books and mandatory health insurance, total cost of attendance USD 90,434 including personal expenses and transportation. No other UAE institution's fee could be verified.

notes: NYUAD's sticker price is high, but its aid policy means very few international students pay it. Read the aid policy before the fee.
NYUAD states that annual adjustments to costs and fees should be expected, so budget above the 2026-27 figures for a 2027 start.
Branch campus fees in Dubai are typically a fraction of the home campus fee in the UK or Australia — but so is the subsidy, so compare the total net cost, not the headline.
The UAE has no income tax, which matters if you plan to work after graduating, but living costs in Dubai and Abu Dhabi are high: rent, car or taxi dependence, and air conditioning.

funding: NYU Abu Dhabi need-based aid — the most important funding line in this file. All financial aid grants offered by NYUAD to non-Emirati citizens are need-based, and the university also offers personal support awards. The only named merit scholarship is the Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed NYUAD Scholarship, which is restricted to admitted UAE nationals and children of an Emirati parent. Apply for aid at the same time as admission.

Khalifa University has historically funded admitted students including internationals with tuition waivers and stipends — this could not be verified in this research and must be confirmed directly with the admissions office.
American University of Sharjah runs merit scholarships including the Sheikh Khalifa Scholarships, which recognise academic excellence and leadership. Amounts not verified.
Branch campuses generally offer modest merit discounts rather than full funding. Do not expect a European-style free place.
Danish SU: a full degree outside the EU/EEA follows separate rules. Check su.dk before budgeting.
Part-time work is restricted on a student residence visa — see workRights. It is not a funding strategy.
workRights: Students on a university-sponsored residence visa may work part-time with a permit, with rules that differ between the mainland and the free zones and have been liberalised in recent years. Not verified from an official source in this research — confirm with the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship and with your university before relying on it.
residency: EU citizenship gives no advantage. Danish citizens receive a visa on arrival as visitors, but you cannot study on that. Your university sponsors a student residence visa, which involves a medical fitness test (including a chest X-ray and blood test) and an Emirates ID. The visa is tied to the institution: if you leave the university, the visa is cancelled. Some students qualify for the UAE's five-year student 'golden visa' for outstanding academic performance.
housing: NYU Abu Dhabi, Khalifa and the American University of Sharjah all house undergraduates on campus, which is the simplest and safest arrangement. Dubai branch campuses vary: some have student accommodation in Dubai International Academic City or Knowledge Village, others expect you to rent privately. Private renting in Dubai usually means paying rent in a small number of large cheques up front, which is hard to manage as a first-year student.
healthcare: Health insurance is legally mandatory for residents in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, and universities normally include a compulsory scheme in the fees — NYUAD lists mandatory health insurance inside its direct costs. Healthcare is private, modern and expensive without cover. Your Danish EHIC does not apply.

institutions.name: New York University Abu Dhabi
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes. A full liberal arts and science curriculum across arts and humanities, engineering, science, social science and interdisciplinary majors, awarding an NYU degree.
institutions.note: A full NYU campus on Saadiyat Island, awarding the New York degree, with study-away semesters across NYU's global network. The defining fact is the money: all aid for non-Emiratis is need-based and the university meets demonstrated need, against a 2026-27 cost of attendance of USD 90,434. Admission is brutally competitive. Confirm the need-blind question with admissions directly.

institutions.name: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, in engineering, computing, science, medicine and business, taught in English.
institutions.note: The UAE's flagship research university and the highest-ranked institution in the country, built around energy, aerospace and AI. It has historically funded admitted students, including internationals, with tuition waivers and stipends — but we could not verify the current policy, so ask before assuming.

institutions.name: American University of Sharjah
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, on an American model: architecture and design, arts and sciences, business, engineering.
institutions.note: The most established American-style university in the Gulf, with a large purpose-built campus and a student body drawn from around ninety countries. Its architecture and design school is the strongest in the region. Merit scholarships include the Sheikh Khalifa Scholarships; fees not verified.

institutions.name: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi
institutions.englishBachelors: Limited. Most programmes are delivered in French following the French university system; some business and economics programmes are taught in English. Verify the language of instruction before applying.
institutions.note: A genuine Sorbonne campus awarding French degrees, overlooking the water on Al Reem Island — and a real option if you have French. Its art history and museology programmes connect directly to the Louvre Abu Dhabi. Check the language of instruction carefully: this is not an English-medium university.

institutions.name: Heriot-Watt University Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes: engineering, construction, business, computer science, psychology, design and fashion — awarding the Scottish Heriot-Watt degree.
institutions.note: The oldest and largest British branch campus in Dubai, awarding the same degree as Edinburgh with the option to transfer between the Dubai, Edinburgh and Malaysia campuses mid-degree. Strong in construction and engineering, which is what Dubai actually does.

institutions.name: University of Birmingham Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, economics, computer science, engineering, psychology and education, awarding the University of Birmingham degree.
institutions.note: A Russell Group university's purpose-built Dubai campus, applying the same entry requirements and awarding the same degree as Birmingham. The most academically conventional of the Dubai options, and the easiest to explain to a European employer.

institutions.name: University of Wollongong in Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, computer science, engineering, media and communication, and finance, awarding the Australian University of Wollongong degree.
institutions.note: The first international university to open in Dubai, in 1993, and still one of the largest. Australian trimester structure means you can finish faster, and credit transfers to the Wollongong campus in New South Wales.

institutions.name: Middlesex University Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: A broad range: business, law, psychology, computing, media, art and design, awarding the UK Middlesex University degree.
institutions.note: The largest British branch campus in the UAE by student numbers, with a broad and accessible course list and a campus in Dubai Knowledge Park. Entry requirements are considerably lower than Birmingham's.

institutions.name: Rochester Institute of Technology Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Engineering, computing, business and information technology, awarding the American RIT degree.
institutions.note: An American technical university's Dubai campus in Silicon Oasis, with the same curriculum and degree as Rochester, New York — including RIT's cooperative-education model of paid industry placements. Students can transfer to the US campus.

institutions.name: American University in Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: American-accredited degrees in business, engineering, architecture, communication, visual communication and interior design.
institutions.note: US-accredited (SACSCOC) and American in structure, with strong design and communication programmes and a central Dubai campus. Private and fee-paying; scholarships are merit discounts rather than full funding.

institutions.name: United Arab Emirates University
institutions.englishBachelors: Most science, engineering, business and medicine programmes are taught in English; some humanities and law programmes are in Arabic.
institutions.note: The country's oldest and largest federal university, in the oasis city of Al Ain. Places and subsidies prioritise Emirati nationals, so international admission is limited — check eligibility before investing effort.

institutions.name: Zayed University
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, communication and media, technological innovation, humanities and social sciences, taught in English.
institutions.note: A federal university originally founded for Emirati women and now co-educational at some levels, with campuses in both Abu Dhabi and Dubai. International intake is limited and prioritised behind nationals.

institutions.name: Canadian University Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, engineering, architecture, communication, environmental health and applied sciences, on a Canadian curriculum model.
institutions.note: Built on a Canadian curriculum with credit-transfer arrangements to Canadian universities, in a landmark tower on Sheikh Zayed Road. A route into a Canadian education without Canadian tuition.

institutions.name: SP Jain School of Global Management, Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor of Business Administration and Bachelor of Data Science, taught across three or four campuses in Dubai, Mumbai, Singapore and Sydney.
institutions.note: Unusual structure: undergraduates rotate between campuses in Dubai, Singapore, Sydney and Mumbai across the degree, which makes it a genuine multi-city education rather than a single-country one. Australian-accredited.
